threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered when the 243 bus goes off-route. Regulars just shrug and hop on the nightbuses instead.
Last night on the 47, an old bloke offered the driver a pint of Best as a tip. Didn't even blink when he got turned down. Classic Bermondsey.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade at Hermannplatz while the next man juggled flaming torches. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a bustling flea market specializing in vintage DDR items and a guy selling homemade vegan döner side by side.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a real local by their grocery cart – they know to hit up the veggie stands before 6 PM for the best deals on slightly bruised avocados.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tux playing a sax on the 6. Only in San Francisco would wedding prep include serenading strangers on Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think the squares here are for lounging. But locals hold their breath until they clear out for the evening. It’s our stage, not theirs.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they’re new when they’re still trying to figure out the difference between ‘café con leche’ and ‘café solo’ at the corner bar.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the tube' means a quick jaunt to the West End, not a frantic scramble just to get to Victoria.
The other night on the 45, I spotted a guy singing to his own reflection in the window, completely unbothered by the rest of us. Classic Brixton moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a kid cycling with a baguette in one hand and a skateboard under the other, I thought, yeah, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a spontaneous techno party erupting in the middle of a street during the day, complete with DJs and a crowd of unbothered locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they casually mention that the BART delays are always worse on Fridays, but they still never take the bus to the city.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy serenading the 31 bus with a ukulele today. Must’ve been a well-rehearsed set, whole ride turned into a mini concert. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best time to visit Plaça del Sol is in the daytime. But it’s the evenings when the locals actually come alive and gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they ask for directions to the nearest 'metro' instead of 'subte' while looking genuinely confused.
